items.title: Oracle, Adobe, and Macy's set to release earnings reports: What to Watch
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch on Thursday, Sept. 10, including earnings reports from Oracle (ORCL), Adobe (ADBE), and Macy's (M), in addition to data from the producer price index.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures, Oracle Jumps After Oil Prices, Yields Surge; CPI Inflation Due
items.summary: The S&P 500 undercut its 50-day as Treasury yields and oil prices surged. Oracle jumped late on earnings. The CPI inflation report could lock in expectations for a Fed rate hike next week.

items.title: Dan Ives Says Software Stocks Just Got Their Clearest Buy Signal Yet
items.summary: Dan Ives says Oracle's earnings and a string of AI-fueled beats give software stocks their clearest signal yet.

items.title: Why Did Autodesk Stock Drop So Soon After Raising Its Forecast?
items.summary: Autodesk (ADSK) shares fell 16.6% in the eight days from their Sep 1 close to Wednesday, Sep 9, ending at $206.62 while the S&P 500 gained 0.1%. The drop came less than two weeks after the software company reported revenue and earnings per share above the top of its guidance and raised its full-year outlook for billings and revenue. For a shareholder, the live question is what Autodesk's growth looks like without a one-time boost to fiscal 2027 revenue.

items.title: Adobe Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Adobe (NASDAQ:ADBE) reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $6.76 billion, up 13% year over year as reported and 12% in constant currency, while also announcing a leadership transition that will take effect Dec. 1. items.title: Adobe Hits 1 Billion Monthly Active Users, Raises Full-Year Outlook
items.summary: Adobe boosted its outlook for the full fiscal year, projecting adjusted earnings between $24.45 and $24.50 a share and revenue between $26.576 billion and $26.626 billion.
